reasons: The cited clause is a genuine deviation: TrueLink's indemnity at 12(b) is limited to its own breach of the Agreement/failure to perform, with no third-party IP infringement defence, no breach-of-law, data-incident or wilful-misconduct coverage anywhere — this fails even the fallback (which requires a Vendor IP indemnity), so a redline is warranted.

The edit is additive and minimal: a new subsection (c) inserted immediately after the existing TrueLink indemnity, tracking the model language and adding standard notice/control/cooperation mechanics without rewriting the surrounding text.

Directionally correct for the customer: it adds Vendor-side protection and does not expand Client's obligations; the drafter reasonably left Client's 12(a) indemnity alone and disclosed that choice in the rationale rather than over-editing.

Comment is accurate, concise and in the required voice, correctly states what changed and why, and offers the fallback (IP-only indemnity with usual exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies).

Defined terms used (Interface, Hosting Services, Support Services, Client Content) are consistent with the agreement's terminology; deterministic checks confirm the inserted vendor IP indemnity is present.
